title: Leyre Jimenez
gallery_text: Preserving the intangible treats vacancy in Harlem not as emptiness, but as a space still holding cultural memory. By weaving communal spaces with other uses, it brings gathering and everyday ritual back into the block, preserving community and cultural memory.

answers.interest: I am interested in learning how to translate data into visually compelling arguments through the use of simulations and models. I want to explore creating different models that can simulate urban problems or even policy decisions.
answers.suggestions: I haven't done extensive research on this yet, but I'm interested in working with climate and environmental modeling tools.
